profile.headline: Principal/Staff Software Engineer | Software Tech Lead | Software Architect | Solutions Engineer | C#, Java, Javascript, C++
profile.summary:
My journey as a software developer began as a little kid, tinkering with databases and writing games. From an early age, I was fascinated by the inner workings of computers, driven by a passion for problem-solving and building things from the ground up.

In college, I chose to major in Physics—not because I was stepping away from programming, but because I wanted to deepen my understanding of the science and mathematics that power engineering. I knew I’d be a software engineer for life, and I wanted a foundation that would make me a better thinker, developer, and innovator. Before graduating summa cum laude, I was hired by Raytheon as a software developer.

Soon after, I became one of the youngest Principal Software Engineers in the company’s history, launching a career where I’ve spent the majority as a Principal Engineer and Technical Lead. I’ve consistently chosen to stay close to the code—leading teams, architecting systems, mentoring engineers, and delivering mission-critical software with both speed and precision.

I’ve earned a reputation as the go-to person who not only gets the job done—but gets it done right. I’ve mentored countless engineers, been recruited based on performance and leadership, and built a career I love by combining deep technical expertise with a passion for clean design and collaborative problem-solving.

I'm fluent in C, C++, C#, Java, Javascript, Python, and UML.  I also have expert insight into XML, JSON, SQL, HTML, SOAP/WSDL, Powershell, and Bash. I'm a process oriented developer with years of experience developing for regulated industries.  I have led projects throughout the whole SDLC including system design and architecture.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Software Engineer, Team Lead at Vivid Cloud
VividCloud is a 100% US-based high-tech software services company. We provide software development services to help our clients with the digital transformation of their products by leveraging cloud computing, IoT, and data engineering technologies.

We design and build new products and systems, and importantly, rearchitect and migrate high value legacy software to the cloud.

VividCloud is an AWS Consulting Partner providing services to the Healthcare Technologies, Industrial, Consumer Devices, Automotive, Financial and Insurance, and Software and Media industries.
